image_description: A single roll of white toilet paper mounted on a wall-mounted holder. The holder is white with a pattern of blue polka dots and small green leaf motifs. The toilet paper roll has a visible cardboard core and a textured, embossed surface. A sheet of paper hangs down from the bottom of the roll.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The blue dots on the right side of the holder appear slightly irregular in shape and spacing compared to the left, suggesting minor warping in the background object generation.
